text:
Posted by Nellie Frank 51 pm NetEase, Inc. (NASDAQ:NTES) Ratings Coverage
Among 5 analysts covering NetEase ( NASDAQ:NTES ), 4 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 1 Hold. Therefore 80% are positive. NetEase had 9 analyst reports since July 3, 2018 according to SRatingsIntel. The stock has “Equal-Weight” rating by Barclays Capital on Thursday, August 30. The rating was maintained by Barclays Capital with “Equal-Weight” on Monday, July 30. Jefferies upgraded NetEase, Inc. (NASDAQ:NTES) on Friday, September 21 to “Buy” rating. The firm has “Overweight” rating by JP Morgan given on Tuesday, July 3. Morgan Stanley upgraded NetEase, Inc. (NASDAQ:NTES) rating on Thursday, December 6. Morgan Stanley has “Overweight” rating and $300 target. On Friday, August 10 the stock rating was maintained by JP Morgan with “Overweight”. The rating was maintained by Nomura with “Buy” on Friday, August 10. The rating was maintained by Nomura on Friday, November 16 with “Buy”. The rating was maintained by Barclays Capital with “Equal-Weight” on Friday, November 16. Below is a list of NetEase, Inc. (NASDAQ:NTES) latest ratings and price target changes.

NetEase, Inc. operates an interactive online community in the PeopleÂ’s Republic of China. The company has market cap of $31.26 billion.
